About Smith Tax Services

Jane Smith, EA, founded the firm in 2004 after twelve years at a regional accounting practice. She is the owner and still prepares returns every season.

Today our team of six includes three enrolled agents and two seasonal preparers. We are a family business and proud to serve Columbus and the surrounding area.

Our values

Clear answers, fair fees, and returns filed on time. We never outsource your return.
